title: Citizen Sentiment Analysis of Municipal Services Using Transformer-Based NLP
description: Team 16 final-review package for exploratory one-month-ahead NYC-2024 municipal forecasting. Includes public code, aggregate cells, original and validation-selected no-VADER family analyses, five-seed uncertainty, raw top-k ranking hits, a separate training-derived fixed burden cutoff, metrics, figures, tests, the revised manuscript, and reproducibility instructions. Selected delay gains remain uncertain and below persistence; conclusions are specific to NYC-2024. Zenodo publication and DOI are pending author action.
